response.sql: WITH qualifying AS (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN `U-PRO` = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN RA = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0), per_patient AS (SELECT l.ID, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(l.TAT - l.TAT2) AS avg_tat_diff FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN qualifying AS q ON l.ID = q.ID GROUP BY l.ID) SELECT AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_pt_of_patients, AVG(avg_tat_diff) AS avg_tat_diff_of_patients FROM per_patient

assumptions.assumption: A patient qualifies if they have at least one lab record with U-PRO = '-' and at least one lab record with RA = '-', not necessarily the same record.

Per-patient averages use all of that patient's lab records. AVG skips NULL PT values, and TAT - TAT2 is NULL unless both TAT and TAT2 are present, so such records are skipped. A patient with no non-null PT drops out of the outer PT average, and one with no complete TAT pair drops out of the TAT average.
Equality with '-' is case-sensitive and exact, as SQLite compares text by default.

alternatives.interpretation: Both conditions must hold on the same laboratory record: the patient needs a single lab record where U-PRO is '-' and RA is '-'. Per-patient averages still use all of that patient's records.
alternatives.sql: WITH qualifying AS (SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE `U-PRO` = '-' AND RA = '-'), per_patient AS (SELECT l.ID, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(l.TAT - l.TAT2) AS avg_tat_diff FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN qualifying AS q ON l.ID = q.ID GROUP BY l.ID) SELECT AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_pt_of_patients, AVG(avg_tat_diff) AS avg_tat_diff_of_patients FROM per_patient
